contentSummary: This sub-topic focuses on equipping learners with the ability to use appropriate language to talk Page 29 of 56 about things found at school. Learners will explore and practice terms used to talk about things found at school. Understanding and applying proper structure to talk about things found at school is an essential communication skill that fosters respect, builds relationships, and promotes social harmony. This sub-topic focuses on equipping learners with values on how to keep their learning environment clean, share the things they like doing with others and explore activities they can engage in to play with others. Learners will explore and practice appropriate language to talk about various activities that happen at school. This will help learners develop essential communication skills that foster hygiene, respect, builds relationships, and promotes social harmony. This sub-topic focuses on equipping learners with knowledge about domestic animals. Domestic animals are important as they contribute to food security, economic benefits and environmental sustainability. Learners will be exposed to different types of domestic animals and their uses. Learners will also explore and practice appropriate language to describe domestic animals. This will enable learners to develop values on how to manage domestic animals effectively, understand their needs and ensure a harmonious relationship between humans and animals.
